sections.Profile:
"Beauty Queens" is a one-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in February 1960. A total of 950 units were produced. Notably, this machine lacks traditional flippers, instead featuring powerful "Super Slingshots" that propel the ball back to the top of the playfield.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, Flipperless
sections.Editions: - Beauty Queens: 950 made, released 1960-02-01, model number 646
